title: GPU Accelerated Maximum Cardinality Matching Algorithms for Bipartite Graphs
gpu_scope: GPU push-relabel-style and augmenting-path GPU algorithms for maximum cardinality bipartite matching (the unweighted case of this problem).
notes: Code is distributed from the Georgia Tech HPC Lab's matchmaker2 project page rather than a git repository; a git clone of this URL is expected to fail and is recorded honestly rather than hidden.
